tasks.instruction_text: Find used 8-cylinder BMWs — apply **BMW** (Make), **Used** (New/Used), and **8-cylinder** (Cylinders) chips in the bottom filter toolbar.

Mirror the Cars.com request: cheapest **used BMW 8-cylinder** priced $25K-$50K. Apply BMW + Used + 8-cylinder chips and the $25,000–$50,000 price band. Confirm all four pills sit in the bottom chip toolbar before reading the cheapest match.
Apply **BMW** + **Used** + **8-cylinder** + **SUV** (body style). Once all four pills are docked in the bottom toolbar, change your mind and × off the SUV body-style chip so you see all body styles.
Cross-shop two German makes: apply **BMW** AND **Mercedes-Benz** under Make, plus **Used** + **8-cylinder**. Then × off the Mercedes-Benz chip so it's only BMW used 8-cylinder.
No filters applied — how many vehicles are listed on AutoLot right now?
Without filtering, which vehicle has the highest customer rating, and what's the rating?
No filters — tell me how many vehicles are priced under $25,000 versus $25,000-and-up.
Apply the **BMW** (Make) chip AND the **8-cylinder** (Cylinders) chip. After both pills are in the bottom toolbar, tell me how many vehicles match.

Multi-step Fara replay: apply **BMW** + **Used** + **8-cylinder** + $25K–$50K price band. Then × off the price-band chip so price is unconstrained. Tell me how many used 8-cylinder BMWs remain across all prices.
Apply **BMW** + **Used** + **8-cylinder** + $25,000–$50,000 price. Verify all four pills are in the toolbar, then name the cheapest used 8-cyl BMW in that price band (model + price).
